entities.name: Carita Holmström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carita Elisabeth Holmström is a Finnish pianist, singer and songwriter, born in Helsinki. She has written and played jazz and classical music during her career. She also formed half of a duo, Carita & Marianne, with Marianne "Maru" Nyman. She represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest 1974 with the song "Keep Me Warm", finishing 13th.

entities.summary: Carita Elisabeth Holmström is a Finnish pianist, singer and songwriter, born in Helsinki. She has written and played jazz and classical music during her career. She also formed half of a duo, Carita & Marianne, with Marianne "Maru" Nyman. She represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest 1974 with the song "Keep Me Warm", finishing 13th.
